messages:
zoe: Tiny poll  whats worse: a YAML file with random tabs, or a semver bump to 3.0.0 with no changelog? :thinking_face:
nate: Tabs in YAML. At least with semver you can cry into release notes. :sob:
claire: Semver 3.0.0 without changelog wins. Thats a trust fall into the void. :scream:
zoe: Proposed penalty: offender must buy donuts and explain the diff in interpretive dance. :doughnut: :man_dancing:
build-bot: Build #452 failed: parser error at line 12 (tabs detected).
nate: build-bot comes through with receipts. :receipt:
claire: I nominate a new office award: "Most Suspicious Versioning". Engraving optional. :trophy:
zoe: Done. Awarded weekly at standup. First recipient: whoever pushed 3.0.0-without-changelog. :point_up:
build-bot: Reminder: please run linter before merging.
zoe: Amen. Also free coffee for anyone who adds a changelog today. :coffee:
